newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat futures rise on Chicago weather concern.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat futures rise on Chicago weather concern.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures rose moderately on Monday, mainly on the strength of Chicago's weather-related strength, Australian brokers said.
The January 1998 contract rose by A$1.00 a tonne to A$182.00 on two lots traded. In other untraded contracts settlement prices rose by between A$1.00 and A$3.00 a tonne.
Kerrin Gleeson of Elders Risk Management said further rallies could occur on U.S. weather concern over Kansas' forecast continued dry. Sydney wheat could reflect that.
Monday's Australian market was not seen influenced by anticipation of tonight's USDA crop forecast, she said.
